status: accepted by owner 2026-10-20 (OD-3), including the extension keys; first tests still verify behavior against real git
decision: owner decision 2026-10-20; keys marked extension are added by this specification and need owner review
rules: The check is read-only. It reports key, origin file (home shown as ~) and remedy; it never prints a value, because values can carry secrets.
A finding does not block readiness; a missing report is a defect.
Matching is case-insensitive on section and variable names, as git does.

remedies.agent_forwarding: forward an agent socket the operator authorizes; no key material enters the container
remedies.path_mapping: map the host path to an existing in-container path, or set the key in an included file the container resolves
remedies.host_only_include: move the key into an include file the container skips because its path is absent
remedies.install_in_container: provide the helper or editor inside the container image
remedies.remove_or_replace: remove the key or replace it with a container-valid value

keys.reason: host helper such as the macOS keychain does not exist in the container
value is a host key path or agent reference
host path; git ignores a missing include silently
condition or target uses host paths; skipped silently when absent
host path; hooks are code that would run in the container

location_findings.xdg: pass: ~/.config/git/config exists and no legacy file
location_findings.legacy_home_file: fail: only ~/.gitconfig exists; a single file cannot be mounted safely; remedy is the guided move on the Mac host (carrying command: OD-5, recommended `whr host git-config move`)
location_findings.split: fail: both exist; git reads both and writes --global to the legacy file; remedy is the guided move
location_findings.absent: fail: no host configuration; remedy is to create the XDG directory on the host; a sandbox never creates it
location_findings.symlink: unknown: the target is not resolved by the check; remedy is to use a real directory
